mutations.label: la matriz vuelve a nombrar solo las regiones con el dominio: el higado desaparece de nutricion
mutations.old: region.to_dict() for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.engine_domains
mutations.new: region.to_dict() for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.domains

mutations.label: la region sin nivel sale en todos los riesgos
mutations.old: region.to_dict() for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.engine_domains
mutations.new: region.to_dict() for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.engine_domains or region.level_of is not None

mutations.label: la region sin nivel sustituye a la del dominio en vez de sumarse
mutations.old: region.to_dict() for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.engine_domains
mutations.new: region.to_dict() for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.engine_domains and (region.level_of is not None or all(domain is not r.level_of for r in anatomy.REGIONS))

mutations.label: la region sin nivel se publica sin decir de quien es su nivel
mutations.old: region.to_dict() for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.engine_domains
mutations.new: {**region.to_dict(), 'level_note': None} for region in anatomy.REGIONS if domain in region.engine_domains
